assumptions: Walking speed is 5.1 km/h on the OSM pedestrian network from extract 2026-10-17.
Waiting at crossings and signals is not modelled; the graph was built without elevation.
Ferry segments may be included and are flagged as includes_ferry.
Barriers and access restrictions reflect OSM tags at the extract date; Valhalla pedestrian costing honours barrier nodes and access=no/private.
Isochrones are grid-derived approximations with 10 m generalization and denoise 1.0; only the largest polygon per contour is retained, so small separate reachable pockets are dropped.
limitations: Estimated walking time is not measured travel time.
Temporary closures, construction, indoor or station passages, and step-free accessibility are not modelled.
Straight-line distance is never walking time.
The public demo server (valhalla1.openstreetmap.de) has a fair-use policy and is not a production backend.
Free software and data do not imply free hosting: graph build requires about 1.7 GB peak RAM and 30 seconds and produces about 165 MB of tiles on this VM; service RSS is about 76 MB idle.
ODbL share-alike obligations apply to derived data.
Graph coverage is limited to the Geofabrik Berlin extract; points just outside Berlin, such as Potsdam, may fail to snap.
